meta.title: 叹气要往上叹！
meta.topic: 声乐教学 · 气息训练

scenes.context: 叹气要往上叹，你不要往下叹。叹气方向影响气息和声带状态。语域：声乐教学，口令式。
sentences: 叹气要往上叹，不要往下叹。
Sighing down drops your breath support.
paraphrase: 往上叹 → sigh upward / exhale up
气息往下掉 → drops the support / breath collapses
scenes.speak: Sigh upward, not downward. Whenever you sigh, sigh upward. Sighing down drops your breath support.

scenes.context: 往下叹：塌肩泄气，唱歌会越来越不好。往下叹气会塌肩泄气，影响唱歌。语域：声乐教学，原理讲解。
sentences: Sighing down: slumped shoulders, leaking air.
气息一旦往下掉，声音就发虚。
Once the breath drops, the voice goes hollow.
paraphrase: 塌肩泄气 → slumped and leaking / shoulders drop, air leaks
声音发虚 → the voice goes hollow / thin and airy
scenes.speak: Sighing down: slumped shoulders, leaking air. Your singing only gets worse. Once the breath drops, the voice goes hollow.

scenes.context: 往上叹：抬头托气，叹气即练气息。往上叹气时抬头托住气息，顺便练了气息。语域：声乐教学，原理+好处。
sentences: Sighing up: lift the head and support the breath.
气息往上送，声音就立起来。
Send the breath upward and the voice stands tall.
paraphrase: 托气 → support the breath / hold the air up
声音立起来 → the voice stands tall / firm and focused
scenes.speak: Sighing up: lift the head and support the breath. Sighing is breath training. Send the breath upward and the voice stands tall.

scenes.title_en: The Drill and Making It a Habit
scenes.context: 练法：微抬下巴、拉长后颈，气息往上送。把往上叹变成习惯——叹气即护嗓。语域：声乐教学，练法收尾。
sentences: 练法：微抬下巴、拉长后颈。
The drill: chin slightly up, back of the neck lengthened.
back of the neck lengthened（拉长后颈）
把往上叹变成习惯——叹气即护嗓。
Make upward sighing a habit — sighing protects your voice.
paraphrase: 拉长后颈 → lengthen the neck / stretch the nape
护嗓 → protect the voice / keep the voice healthy
scenes.speak: The drill: chin slightly up, back of the neck lengthened. Send the breath upward. Make upward sighing a habit — sighing protects your voice.

practice: Sighing down: slumped shoulders, leaking air — singing gets worse.
Sighing is breath training — send the breath upward and the voice stands tall.
Chin slightly up, neck lengthened — make upward sighing a habit.
pitfalls: Sighing down: slumped shoulders, leaking air.
The voice goes hollow when the breath drops.
Sighing is good for the throat.
shifts: 用 sigh upward（往上叹）、support the breath（托气）、breath training（练气息）
用 goes hollow（发虚）、stands tall（立起来）、thin and airy（虚而飘）
用 slumped shoulders（塌肩）、chin slightly up（微抬下巴）、lengthen the neck（拉长后颈）
